children: Hawkeye Digital made available an investor presentation describing its public incubator and merchant banking strategy, investment criteria, and go‑forward roadmap.
Furnished investor presentation as Exhibit 99.1 on Oct 13, 2026 under Regulation FD; presentation not "filed" for certain SEC liabilities.
Describes strategy to combine advisory fees, balance‑sheet investing, and merchant banking to build a public incubator in digital assets, future finance, and frontier tech.
Details investment criteria: revenue‑generating companies ($2–20M projected EBITDA), minority and control positions, liquidity horizon ~24 months.
Discloses a specific Pubco transaction: $300K cash advisory fee, $550K invested for 91.7M warrants at $0.006 each ($0.004 exercise), plus fee warrants and a 4.5M‑share option.
Outlines risks and roadmap: need for capital, limited operating history, regulatory risk, planned senior hires, uplisting prep, and asset management launch in early 2028.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
